lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Then what happens after that?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Is she alive yet?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: OK.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: What happens after you were done watching TV for 15 minutes.

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: I told him I had to leave cuz I had ta call Travis.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Brendan, be honest. You were there when she died and we know that. Don't start lying now. We know you were there. What happened?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: He ain't gonna lie to you, hey we know that OK.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: We already know, don't lie to us now, OK, come on. What happens next?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: You're just hurting yourself if you lie now.

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Then he went in, back in there and he stabbed her.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: You were with him? (Brendan nods “yes”) Yes?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Where did he stab her?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: In the stomach.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: What else did he do to her? (pause) He did something else, we know that.
(pause) What else?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: So he tried, she, he tied her up.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: What do you mean he tied her up?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: So he could take her out there.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Before or after he stabbed her?
